1: // Simple Laser Slice game implementation
2: // Canvas with id="game"
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
8:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
9: 
10:   // Player dot
11:   const player = {
12:     x: width / 2,
13:     y: height - 50,
14:     radius: 8,
15:     speed: 2,
16:     color: '#ff6600',
17:   };
18: 
19:   // Obstacles: simple rectangles
20:   const obstacles = [];
21:   const obstacleSize = { w: 60, h: 20 };
22:   const obstacleColor = '#444';
23: 
24:   // Laser state
25:   const laser = { length: 40, width: 4, cooldown: 500, lastFired: 0 };
26: 
27:   // Utility: check rectangle intersect line segment
28:   function lineIntersectsRect(x1, y1, x2, y2, rect) {
29:     // Simple AABB check for each side of rect
30:     const { x, y, w, h } = rect;
31:     // Check if line segment passes through rectangle bounds
32:     // Using Liang-Barsky algorithm (simplified)
33:     let t0 = 0, t1 = 1;
34:     const dx = x2 - x1, dy = y2 - y1;
35:     const p = [-dx, dx, -dy, dy];
36:     const q = [x1 - x, x + w - x1, y1 - y, y + h - y1];
37:     for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
38:       if (p[i] === 0) {
39:         if (q[i] < 0) return false; // Parallel and outside
40:       } else {
41:         const r = q[i] / p[i];
42:         if (p[i] < 0) {
43:           if (r > t1) return false;
44:           if (r > t0) t0 = r;
45:         } else {
46:           if (r < t0) return false;
47:           if (r < t1) t1 = r;
48:         }
49:       }
50:     }
51:     return t0 <= t1;
52:   }
53: 
54:   function spawnObstacle() {
55:     const x = Math.random() * (width - obstacleSize.w);
56:     const y = -obstacleSize.h; // start above view
57:     obstacles.push({ x, y, w: obstacleSize.w, h: obstacleSize.h });
58:   }
59: 
60:   // Main loop
61:   function update(timestamp) {
62:     // Move player forward (upwards)
63:     player.y -= player.speed;
64: 
65:     // Remove obstacles that are far below view
66:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
67:       if (obstacles[i].y > height) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
68:     }
69: 
70:     // Spawn obstacles ahead of player
71:     if (Math.random() < 0.02) spawnObstacle();
72: 
73:     // Draw
74:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
75:     // Draw player
76:     ctx.fillStyle = player.color;
77:     ctx.beginPath();
78:     ctx.arc(player.x, player.y, player.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
79:     ctx.fill();
80: 
81:     // Draw obstacles
82:     ctx.fillStyle = obstacleColor;
83:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
84:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
85:     });
86: 
87:     requestAnimationFrame(update);
88:   }
89: 
90:   // Laser handling
91:   function fireLaser() {
92:     const now = Date.now();
93:     if (now - laser.lastFired < laser.cooldown) return; // cooldown
94:     laser.lastFired = now;
95:     // Laser line from player forward (upwards)
96:     const x1 = player.x;
97:     const y1 = player.y - player.radius;
98:     const x2 = player.x;
99:     const y2 = y1 - laser.length;
100:     // Visual
101:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,255,255,0.7)';
102:     ctx.lineWidth = laser.width;
103:     ctx.beginPath();
104:     ctx.moveTo(x1, y1);
105:     ctx.lineTo(x2, y2);
106:     ctx.stroke();
107:     // Remove intersecting obstacles
108:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
109:       if (lineIntersectsRect(x1, y1, x2, y2, obstacles[i])) {
110:         obstacles.splice(i, 1);
111:       }
112:     }
113:   }
114: 
115:   // Input
116:   canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', fireLaser);
117: 
118:   // Start
119:   requestAnimationFrame(update);
120: })();

(End of file - total 120 lines)
